desc: Ideation: derive block decomposition T(X,Y) = cumF_{y0}[X] + (cumG_{x0}[Y] − cumG_{x0}[y0]) + leftover cross-sum; confirm int64 safety and complexity budget
Implement full solution (I/O, block size S, cross helper, grouped y0 term1, grouped x0 term2, per-query leftover term3, output)

Validate correctness (algebraic proof of decomposition and of the |a−b| prefix-sum kernel, full hand-trace of Sample 1, edge cases N=1, x0=0, y0=0, exact block multiples, duplicates/extremes, overflow audit)

Performance design/tuning: dedupe duplicate (X,Y), one boundary build per distinct x0/y0 via compression+bincount (O(N) per build, ≤~200 builds), cached per-block argsort for term3, S ≈ N/√K — estimated well under the time limit
